decisions.reason: The data processing agreement software builds on the firm's knowledge of agency clients and GDPR-related hosting, and early customer feedback praising its agency-focused templates is something the firm can read and use to improve the product.

The web hosting management platform sits at the core of the firm's existing hosting expertise and is featured on the home page, so it draws directly on related knowledge the firm can absorb and develop further.
The configurable managed hosting plan is a close extension of the firm's established hosting business, so it builds strongly on existing knowledge despite the lack of reported results so far.
